role: iOS app privacy manifest: tracking declaration, collected data types and required-reason API declarations.
toplevel: NSPrivacyTracking false, no tracking domains. Collected data types (all for App Functionality, none for tracking): Health (linked), Fitness (linked), PreciseLocation (linked), CoarseLocation (not linked), AudioData (not linked), OtherUserContent (linked), Contacts (linked), EmailAddress (linked), PhysicalAddress (linked), SearchHistory (linked). Accessed API types: UserDefaults with CA92.1 (app's own defaults) and 1C8F.1 (App Group defaults - used by UnitsPreference/DataPurgeService/Constants+SleepAndDisplay UserDefaults(suiteName:)); FileTimestamp C617.1 (file dates inside the app/group container - Archive+Trash, TrashRestoreCoordinator, ExportAndArchiveViews, CrashLogManager read creation/modification dates). No SystemBootTime, DiskSpace or ActiveKeyboards APIs are used in app sources (grep for systemUptime, mach_absolute_time, CACurrentMediaTime, volumeAvailableCapacity, statfs, activeInputModes finds none). Bundled in Resources (pbxproj 3618). Third-party SDKs (PolarBleSdk, WhisperKit and its dependencies) are expected to ship their own manifests; that is outside this file.
